##### Project general facts

Shahrukhz by Danube is a landmark premium office development, created as a statement address for business leaders, founders, and visionaries. Inspired by the self-made journey of Shahrukh Khan, the project celebrates ambition, success, and the pursuit of building a lasting legacy. Its striking architecture and prestigious location provide exceptional visibility, while a thoughtfully designed business environment creates a distinctive setting for companies looking to establish themselves at a prominent Dubai address.

Designed far beyond the traditional office concept, Shahrukhz offers a dynamic ecosystem where productivity, networking, wellness, and leisure come together. The development features a grand double-height lobby, valet parking, a networking hub, podcast studio, board and meeting rooms, multipurpose hall, business lounges, a sky pool, gym, club house, tranquility and urban gardens, as well as padel, badminton, and cricket facilities. Dedicated conveniences such as shuttle access to the metro, electric car charging, e-scooter parking, drone docking, and a helipad further enhance the experience, creating a workplace designed around the modern needs of ambitious businesses.

The office spaces are planned to accommodate different business formats, from thoughtfully organized workplaces with manager’s cabins, reception and visitor areas to larger customized offices with conference rooms, pantries, and generous outdoor seating. With its combination of a prestigious Sheikh Zayed Road address, sophisticated business infrastructure, and an extensive collection of lifestyle amenities, Shahrukhz by Danube presents a new generation of premium commercial real estate where every office is designed to become part of a story of success.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Sufouh offers a vibrant and dynamic neighbourhood that beautifully blends natural beauty, outdoor activities, and convenient access to Dubai's most iconic destinations. This exceptional area is home to beautifully landscaped parks, scenic jogging tracks, and cycling paths that invite residents to embrace an active and health-conscious lifestyle amidst the fresh air and tranquillity. The neighbourhood's well-connected road network, including Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Sufouh Road, ensures seamless transportation links to every corner of the city.

Life within Al Sufouh is defined by its strategic location and exceptional connectivity, with the Dubai Metro's Red Line running through the area and providing effortless commuter access. The neighbourhood's proximity to some of Dubai's most coveted destinations, including The Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina, places residents at the heart of the city's vibrant lifestyle. From luxurious hotels and resorts to bustling dining and entertainment scenes, every desire is always just a short drive away.

The surroundings of Al Sufouh offer a treasure trove of attractions and experiences that cater to every interest and preference, from stunning beaches to world-class leisure facilities. The area's unique blend of natural beauty, recreational opportunities, and convenient access to key destinations makes it an ideal location for those who value a balanced and refined lifestyle. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the serenity of a peaceful neighbourhood with the dynamic allure of one of the world's most exciting cities.
